subjects.name: Application of Computer in Color Matching & Textile Design
subjects.name_print: BHT701 Application of Computer in Color Matching & Textile Design
subjects.marks_print: 3 0 0 | 20 10 30 | - | 70 | - | 100 | 3 (p.2 Sem-VII scheme row 1; header columns L T P | CT TA Total | PS | TE | PE | Total | Credit)

units.1: Colour Theory- Introduction, colour physics, sources and types of illumination, various colour theories, additive-subtractive mixing, and colour specification systems. Munsell system, colour difference, Degree of  Metamerism, colour order system, colour difference formulae, Anatomy of a colour measuring Instrument, Beer – Lambert law  and Kubelka – Munk theory.
units.2: Instrumentation of colour matching and assessment-  Specular and diffusion reflectance, measurement of reflectance, Instruments for colour matching, ,   CCM software, CIE LAB color space, Application to textiles- Preparation of sample calibration, reflectance spectra of sample, Prediction of the recipes by computer and verification of result- Pass/Fail system.
units.3: Introduction of computer application in textile designing – fundamentals- different methods and advantages of CATD. Basics of computer designing, importance of CATD.  Decorative effect using pattern and design theory, Application of CAD for textiles.
units.4: Transfer of designs to point paper- various steps in transferring designs from sketch to point paper. Design calculation as per given jacquard and harness set – pixel – resolution and its relation with threads and threads per inch. Vector and raster images – X and Y in designing – different drawing tools.
units.5: Motif Scanning – scanning parameters – colours and attributes, editing tools used for graph making – scaling, rotating, reversing, dropping. Application CATD Softwares - Basic Operations, Drawing Operations, Working With Colors, Working With Contours, Using Layers, Transform Tools, Brushes, Using Filters, Cleaning Up the Picture.

cos.text: Explain about the concept of different colour theories.
Apply the applications in CCM software.
Explainthe fundamentals of CATD.
Creation of design bytransferring on to point paper.
Apply the different tools for creating the designs by CATD.

objectives_print: To enable the students to define the concept of different colour theories.
To enable the students to analyze the applications in CCM software.
To enable the students to narrate about the fundamentals of CATD.
To enable the students to learn about transfer of designs on to point paper.
To enable the students to use the applications in CATD software.

subjects.name: Functional Textiles
subjects.marks_print: 3 0 0 | 20 10 30 | - | 70 | - | 100 | 3 (p.2 Sem-VII scheme row 2 'BHT070-072 Departmental Elective–IV'; header columns L T P | CT TA Total | PS | TE | PE | Total | Credit)

units.1: Introduction to functional textiles,definition and scope for technical textiles, brief idea about technical fibers, role ofyarn and fabric construction. Filtration textiles- Definition of filtration parameters, theory of dust collection and solid liquid separation, filtration requirements, concept of pore size andparticle size, role of fiber, fabric construction and finishing treatments.
units.2: Geotextiles- Brief idea about geosynthetics and their uses, essential properties of geotextiles, Geotextile structure forms, application examples of geotextiles. Introduction to composite materials- Fibre Reinforced Composites, Functions of fibre and matrix in composites, applications of composites. Introduction to Smart Textiles- Applications and Markets.
units.3: Textiles in defence- Criteria for modern military textile materials, Incompatibilities in military materials systems, Textiles for environmental protection, Thermal insulation materials, Water vapour permeable/waterproof materials. Protective Clothing- Brief idea about different type of protective clothing, functional requirement of textiles in ballistic protection materials, parachute cloth, flame retardant clothing,chemical protective clothing.
units.4: Automotive Textiles- Application of textiles in automobiles, requirement and design for different tyres, airbags and belts, methods of production and properties of textiles used in these applications. Sportswear– apparel with performance-enhancing characteristics such as moisture management, comfort, elastomeric, soil guard, anti-microbial–sports shirts, athletic wear.
units.5: Medical textiles- Fibres used, Non-implantable materials, Extracorporeal devices, Implantable materials, Healthcare/hygiene products. Agro Textiles- Characteristics of agro-textiles, Fibers for agro-textiles, techniques for producing agro textile products, area of applications in agro textiles.

cos.text: Todescribe the concept of technical textiles and filtration textiles.
To illustratethe concept of geotextiles and composite materials.
To describethe concept of textiles use in defense and protective textiles.
To exploreautomotive textiles and sports textiles.
To understand about Medical textilesand agricultural textiles.

subjects.name: Apparel Marketing and Merchandising
subjects.marks_print: 3 0 0 | 20 10 30 | - | 70 | - | 100 | 3 (p.2 Sem-VII scheme row 2 'BHT070-072 Departmental Elective–IV'; header columns L T P | CT TA Total | PS | TE | PE | Total | Credit)

units.1: Introduction to Apparel Business- International apparel business pattern, basic business concepts in Indian apparel export house, business operations in China and other south Asian countries. Business patterns for Indian apparel retail and home textiles. Understanding from concept board to finished product and its sequence.
units.2: Marketing for Apparel and Textile Products-Defining marketing, marketing mix the objectives of marketing department, market research, different types of markets, marketing strategies with respect to a product/brand, Indian apparel houses international marketing strategies and domestic marketing strategies, marketing models, B to B marketing, B to C marketing, direct marketing, digital marketing, E-Marketing.
units.3: Merchandising-Concepts of merchandising, concepts and apparel product lines, dimensions of product change, determination and development of product line and product range. Creative and technical design in garments and accessories, new product development and seasons of sale, costing, coordination and communication with the production house and export house.
units.4: Sourcing-Understanding the basics of sourcing, sourcing strategy and best sourcing practice in apparel and textile businesses, supply chain and demand chain understanding, sourcing negotiations, global co-ordination in sourcing, materials management and quality in sourcing, quick response and supplier partnership insourcing, JIT technology.
units.5: Export Documentation and Policies-Government policies a guide lines for apparel export and domestic trade, tax structures and government incentives in apparel trade. Export documents and its purposes, banking activities, Letter of credit, logistics and shipping, foreign exchange regulation, export risk management and insurance. Export finance, Special economic zones. Goods & Services Tax.

The concepts of sourcing, strategy and best practice in apparel and textile businesses, supply chain.

subjects.name: Advanced Fabric Structure
subjects.marks_print: 3 0 0 | 20 10 30 | - | 70 | - | 100 | 3 (p.2 Sem-VII scheme row 2 'BHT070-072 Departmental Elective–IV'; header columns L T P | CT TA Total | PS | TE | PE | Total | Credit)

units.1: Figuring with extra threads – extra warp and extra weft – designing and comparison. Extra warp and Extra weft figuring techniques using healds, healds with dobby and healds with jacquard. Anchoring of spot effects. Figured warp backed cloth and weft backed cloth.Damsk using pressure harness, bannister harness system and self-twilling jacquard.
units.2: Figured Patent satin- structures of cloth -use of straight tie with healds, Designing,  simplified enlargement and punching techniques and use of working comber board for saving of punched cards designing and simplified enlargement technique. Figured pique- structures of cloth, Use of straight tie with healds, Designing simplified enlargement and punching technique.
units.3: Tapestry – Traditional tapestries, Simple weft faced tapestries, Modern tapestry- structure of cloth. 3 pick tapestry using jacquard and heald method. Designing and simplified enlargement and punching techniques. Figured terry 3 pick, 4 pick terry- graph designing, punching technique for straight tie, straight draft and sectional Draft and sectional tie, sectional draft with healds.
units.4: Figured double cloth- design development and punching process for straight harnessing with sectional draft and sectional harnessing with sectional draft, FiguredLeno and gauze fabrics – Salient features, Indication of leno structures, drafting plan and lifting plan of straight and pointed draft structures. Thread interlacing diagram of leno structures, Combination of Leno, Plain and Twill– Drafting plan and Lifting plan.
units.5: Study of traditional Handloom Fabrics of India – Kanchipuram Saree – Banaras, Brocades and Sarees – Jamdani Sarees – Paithani Sarees – Chanderi Sarees– Patola Sarees – Pochampalli Tie and Dye Sarees –Kota Doria- Baluchar Saree-Feature of Riha- Lysemphy-Mekhala-Woollen Shawl- Tweed-Himaroo Shawls. Quality particulars of Reserved Handloom Fabrics-Dothi-Shirting-Dress Material-Home Furnishing-Made ups-Floor coverings.

cos.text: Apply figured extra warp and extra weft and figured double cloth with simplified graph enlargement and punching.
Develop the traditional and modern tapestries and simplified graph enlargement of modern tapestry and figured terry.
Create the figured pique and figured patent satin and simplified graph enlargement of figured pique and figured patent satin.
Established design of leno and gauze fabrics.
Develop design on Dobby & Jacquard through CAD creation.

objectives_print: To enable the students to create figured extra warp and extra weft and figured double cloth with simplified graph enlargement and punching.
To enable the students to develop traditional and modern tapestries and simplified graph enlargement of modern tapestry and figured terry.
To enable the students to create figured pique and figured patent satin and simplified graph enlargement of figured pique and figured patent satin.
To enable the students to established leno and gauze fabrics and traditional handloom fabrics of India.
To enable the students to develop design by Dobby & Jacquard through CAD creation
